title: Eventstream, Spark Structured Streaming or KQL: choose the engine
objective_text: Choose between an eventstream, Spark Structured Streaming and an eventhouse queried with KQL for four streaming jobs, and say why.
scenario: Clickwell streams events from its web shop. One team wants no-code routing, one wants live interactive queries, and one writes PySpark.
verifies: You can pick the right tool or store for each scenario, with the reason and source shown afterwards.
does_not_verify: That you can build it in Fabric: nothing is set up or run here. Doing it on a real item is FABRIC VERIFIED work.

validation.fail: Not all right yet: reread the lesson's notes and try again.
